subject: Q2 close: Proposal for $5k usage credit to extend pilot
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Riley <jordan@cloudsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 close: Proposal for $5k usage credit to extend pilot

Jordan —

Thanks again for the call today. You mentioned the team just needs another two weeks to validate throughput on the ingest pipeline before a firm commit. We can do a short pilot extension and put a meaningful convert/close incentive in place to help hit procurement timelines before EoQ.

High-level proposal (one-time, applied as account credit):
- $5,000 usage credit applied to the first month after contract signature
- 30-day pilot extension (same scope as current POC)
- No change to data controls or SLA terms — standard enterprise terms remain

If that sounds good I can route a promo approval internally and send a DocuSign amendment. Marissa/Neha — I flagged this as an EoQ close candidate; attaching the Q2 usage snapshot for context.

Attachments: CloudSync_Q2_usage_snapshot.csv

Next steps: please confirm and I’ll start the approval flow. If you need a different structure (credit over two months, or applied to committed spend), say the word and I’ll tailor.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0198

From: Jordan Riley <jordan@cloudsync.io>

Date: Sat, 28 Jun 2025 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 close: Proposal for $5k usage credit to extend pilot

Sean —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. $5k applied as a first-month credit sounds ideal and should get our procurement team across the line. Wed like the amendment to state: 30-day pilot extension, credit applied upon signature, and list the specific model variants covered by the credit (were only evaluating the small quantized profile).

If you can send the DocuSign and a short statement of work, well move the legal review to the top. Targeting an internal signature by the end of next week.

Thanks,
Jordan Riley
Head of Platform Engineering, CloudSync
jordan@cloudsync.io

Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fw: Q2 close: Proposal for $5k usage credit to extend pilot

Looping you both in — quick internal note for approval routing.

Sean: please confirm the following so I can submit to Finance for a promotional credit (needs VP sign-off for >$3k):
- Effective start/end dates for the extension
- Whether credit is refundable or only applies to token usage (we typically tie to invoice adjustments)
- Any change to SLAs or support level (should be none)

Ive attached the standard promo approval form and the usage snapshot Sean shared. If Finance approves we will generate a short amendment and a DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: CloudSync_promo_approval_form.pdf, CloudSync_Q2_usage_snapshot.csv

Marissa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 close: Proposal for $5k usage credit to extend pilot

Marissa/team —

Approved. Finance reviewed the usage snapshot and supports a $5,000 one-time credit applied as an invoice adjustment (non-refundable). Conditions: credit must be consumed within the first 60 days after contract signature, and the customer must sign the amendment (DocuSign) within 14 days of receiving the envelope. No SLA changes.

Ill route the approval memo to Legal and Ops for recordkeeping; Marissa, please attach this memo to the HubSpot deal.

Neha Kapoor
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Riley <jordan@cloudsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: $5k credit + amendment (DocuSign)

Jordan —

Great news: Finance has approved the $5,000 one-time usage credit (terms below). Ive created the amendment and opened a DocuSign envelope. Link: https://www.docusign.net/123456789

Approved terms (summary):
- $5,000 one-time credit applied as an invoice adjustment to the first invoice after signature
- 30-day pilot extension from the amendment effective date
- Credit must be consumed within 60 days of signature (non-refundable)
- No changes to existing SLAs or data controls

Attached: short amendment (PDF) + the usage snapshot you requested. Please review and sign; once signed Ill confirm the credit posting schedule and schedule a kickoff for the extended pilot.

Attachments: CloudSync_promo_approval_form.pdf, CloudSync_Q2_usage_snapshot.csv

Thanks again for working with us to accelerate this — let me know if you want the credit split across two invoices instead of a lump sum and Ill update the amendment.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
